q.en: Which wartime gallantry honour stands third in India's order?

q.en: Which peacetime gallantry honour ranks third in India?

q.en: The Ramon Magsaysay Award was instituted in which year?

explanation.en: People often call the Right Livelihood Award the Alternative Nobel Prize.
